title: Pink Grab Bar, 63-Inch Wall Mount 3-Post ADA Compliant Iron Pipe, Pipeline Collection, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Pink, grab bar, 63-inch length, wall mount 3-post design in iron pipe for bathroom safety and accessibility, which brings playful, modern energy to bathroom design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality. ADA compliant bathroom grab bar provides balance and secure support for seniors, caregivers, and users needing added stability; rated 250 lb capacity. Extended-length bar uses three mounting posts including a center bracket for enhanced stability and a compact 3.58 in projection. Industrial pipe-style bath accessories look fits loft bathroom fixtures and industrial bathroom hardware designs; protected with a durable powder coat finish for corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass Pipeline collection.
